author: Zintenka
body:
99 wanted to make a TNT map and I wanted to make a map... so we did this.



Authors 
Para - Original map maker of the series, gave permission for 99 and me to make the map
99250 - Idiot who decided to make this stupid map
Zintenka - The fool who decided to help him 



Features
- TNT, Yes... Tons and tons of it...



- Can't place TNT by wool areas
- Defensive/Offesensive cannon emplacements.
Arc/Router cannons by spawn to repel skybridges

Whips at mid level


Mini whiskies to deal with mid-liners


- Limited Iron supply, cannot place TNT around it but TNT can blow it up from cannoneers
- 2 wools on each side, each with their own personalities!
Pink the Lustful One

Orange the Rude One

Purple the Aggressive One

Yellow the Commanding One

Download
XML - Uh-Uh.
Imgur

replies.body:
I'll perhaps see what I can do about the wool lanes that could make attacking easier like jump boost or something.

The TNT supplies are located inside the bunker filled with the Whips and an underground bunker like thing. I decided to go for a little design with the supplies because the generic layout was sort getting a bit overdone. Just wanted to be unique :D

99 put those there not to be able to fire at the other team's side... but to counter cheeky skybridges since that's the purpose of those cannons, we want newer players to take example from those cannons and hopefully be able to create some of their own, y'know?

Aesthetics are fine.

replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
As explained, we want to introduce people to TNT gameplay and cannons because as it stands, people on Avicus are very unfamiliar with cannons and we want to introduce people to cannon gameplay with pre-built ones.

I'll probably consider making the cannons indestructible but you can place TNT by them so that newer players can have the chance to build cannons and place TNT in an arrangement UNTIL they get it right.

If we allowed players to enter the wool rooms via the clouds then adding a path would be redundant. We can add no enter regions y'know.

Also, who said that there had to be a criteria for a TNT map? Adding a large void gap would just influence bridging, bridging and more bridging.

We wanted to cater to all playstyles whether you're a rusher or a cannoneer or a defender.

Also, we already tested how TNT would play out ingame on 99's server, the map can definitely support some good TNT gameplay.

However, I do agree that the path needs to be a bit wider though... maybe we can keep this version as TE whilst the public version has a wider path?

I'll speak with 99 about this

replies.body: I don't quite know what is and isn't possible with Avicus XML, but is there no way to make a region where team members cannot damage their own team's side with TNT, but the other team can? If there is, something like this could be implanted around the areas of the cannons.
replies.body_tagged: I don't quite know what is and isn't possible with Avicus XML, but is there no way to make a region where team members cannot damage their own team's side with TNT, but the other team can? If there is, something like this could be implanted around the areas of the cannons.

replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
Yes, this is possible actually but not through checks but through this:

        <join id="unbreakable-blocks">
            <fill bounds="map" materials="quartz block;step:7;stained glass:5;stained glass:14;sign;ladder;wool;stone button" start="104,0,31"/>
            <cuboid id="map" min="231, 75, 141" max="-23, 0, -79"/>
        </join>

Bounds is the cuboid that is being referenced which is like the boundary in which the plugin will search for these unbreakable blocks.

Since the cuboid has the id know as "map" the <fill></fill> region identifies this one as the specific region and all the "materials=" will be known as the ones which won't be broken.

        <zone region="unbreakable-blocks" modify="never">
            <message>^f^lCan't destroy these blocks.</message>
        </zone>

This is the <Zone> region; you can see the similarities it has with OCN's <apply> region. It basically dictates whether you can teleport, build stuff or not and etc.

The "modify=never" says that all of these blocks won't be modified.

Sorry for the lecture, just wanted to show you the slight similarities so that all those observant OCNers can get the gist, y'know?

EDIT: Derp. I meant this for specific team:

    <checks>
        <deny id="deny-break">
            <material>stained glass:10</material>
            <material>stained glass:1</material>
        </deny>
        <!-- Stops teams from placing TNT at specified areas -->
        <all id="deny-tnt">
            <not id="deny-tnt-purple">
                <material>tnt</material>
                <team>Junr Empire</team>
            </not>
            <not id="deny-tnt-orange">
                <material>tnt</material>
                <team>Zin Egalitarium</team>
            </not>
        </all>
    </checks>

    <zones>
        <zone region="monument-purp" place="deny-tnt-purp">
            <message>^f^lYOU can't place TNT here.</message>
        </zone>
        <zone region="monument-oran" place="deny-tnt-oran">
            <message>^f^lYOU can't place TNT here.</message>
        </zone>
        <zone region="wools" modify="deny-tnt" place="deny-break" break="deny-break">
            <message>^f^lCan't use TNT or break glass or wool.</message>
        </zone>
    </zones>
